name: MKT_CAMP_BATCH_JOB_ITEMS
description: To store details of ESS jobs corresponding to each campaign object.

columns.name: JOB_ID
columns.description: Batch ID. All job items created from one parent batch job have the same batch ID.

columns.name: JOB_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Job Item ID, which is an index number within the job items with the same job ID.

columns.name: ESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Specifies the request ID of the ESS Job.

columns.name: CAMPAIGN_ID
columns.description: Campaign ID, for which the job item is being processed.

columns.name: CAMPAIGN_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Campaign Account ID, for which the job item is being processed.

columns.name: LEAD_ID
columns.description: Specifies the Lead ID of generated lead.

columns.name: JOB_ITEM_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the Job Item. Possible values are: NOTSTARTED, INPROGRESS, ERRORED, COMPLETED.

columns.name: REQUEST_PAYLOAD
columns.description: Json Payload that is sent over to Eloqua.

columns.name: RESPONSE_PAYLOAD
columns.description: Json payload that is received as response from Eloqua.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Contains the error stack trace and error message, whenever an object (job item) fails.

columns.name: BULK_EXPORT_SYNC_ID
columns.description: Specifies the Eloqua's Bulk Export Job Sync ID.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
